results.subject: Order not arrived after 2 weeks
results.resolution_strategy: Address the delivery delay and reassure the customer. Suggest expedited shipping for replacement or next order.

results.subject: Wrong item delivered
results.resolution_strategy: Address the issue by confirming the error and arranging a redelivery of the correct item with clear instructions on what customers should do if any issue persists.

results.subject: Billing error on March invoice
